newsitem.title: UK: Redrow chairman to sell shares.
newsitem.headline: Redrow chairman to sell shares.

text.p: UK construction company Redrow Group Plc said its chairman Steve Morgan intends to sell approximately 54 million shares in the comapny through his Bridgemere Holdings Ltd company.
Morgan will control about 35 percent of Redrow after the sale, the company said in a statement with its half year results.
Redrow also said that managing director Paul Pedley intends to sell 475,000 Redrow shares following recent exercises of options. Pedley will control 500,000 Redrow shares after the proposed sale.
Redrow said BZW Securities Ltd and Cazenove & Co will be joint lead managers and bookrunners to the offerings.
Morgan said in the results statement that Redrow was "in excellent shape for continued growth and I am confident that the recovery in the housing market is set to continue."
Redrow reported a rise in profit to 16.4 million stg in the six months ended December 31, 1996 from 12.1 million a year earlier. Turnover rose by 29 percent to 123.2 million.
Morgan said that although house price inflation had been strongest in certain locations in south east England, house price improvement had on the whole been steady.
